text.en: CT and GLM: matched controls, independent checks and grid/time convergence Compare CT and GLM discretizations with a matched flux family, LLF coefficient, time steps and fixed physical damping. Use a constructed smooth exact solution and independent Athena++ results to separate spatial, time-integration and reference differences. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-mhd-convergence-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic unit square, gamma5/3, mu0=1, planar MHD. A=.05[cos2pi(x−.3t)+cos2pi(y−.2t)], B=(Ay,−Ax), rho1, v=(.3,.2), p=.1+(2pi)²A²/2 at t=.1. Compare analytic conserved cell averages. This is a constructed verification case, not a claimed published standard benchmark. Editorial clarification This translating smooth equilibrium is an exact solution constructed for the Atlas. Compare conserved cell averages, distinguishing pressure recovered from them from the exact cell average of pressure. A separate time integrator on the same spatial semidiscretization checks time error; it is not an independent PDE solver. Adopted numerical method Both use piecewise constants, the same fixed Rusanov speed alpha3 and forward Euler. CT uses face B/shared arithmetic corner EMFs; GLM uses cell B/psi with fixed ch3 and physical damping rate kappa2. All meshes use384 steps and identical CT/GLM dt sequences; initial reconstructed CT cell B matches GLM cell B. A=a[cos⁡k(x−ut)+cos⁡k(y−vt)],B=(Ay,−Ax),Jz=−ΔA=k2A p=p0+12k2A2,∇p=Jz∇A=J×B Uˉij=1ΔxΔy∫KijU dx dy,p(Uˉ)≠pˉ Um+1=Um+Δt Lh(Um),Csum=αΔt(Δx−1+Δy−1) References and measured quantities Measure conserved-variable L1/L2/Linf errors and observed orders at16²/32²/64². Compare finest-grid step doubling with.1 of the spatial error. At fixed8², compare16/32/64/128 steps with doubly refined DOP853 tolerances/max steps. Record mass/E, positivity, native CT divergence, common cell divergence and psi. Verification limits and failures With constant LLF viscosity and periodic centered operators, the GLM div=psi=0 subspace remains invariant up to roundoff. This tests coupled-MHD accuracy; a separate nonphysical control activates cleaning. p(q-average) is not the exact averaged p. DOP853 is independent in time only and shares the spatial RHS. Step differences are empirical contamination indicators, not rigorous bounds; face/cell representation differences remain part of the comparison. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.ja: 制約輸送法／CT
GLM発散クリーニング
理想MHD

note.ja: 透磁率を1とする理想MHDの代表形。Eは熱・運動・磁場を含む全エネルギー密度。解説でCT・GLMと発散の測り方、HLLDテストへ進めます。 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。
note.en: Representative ideal MHD with magnetic permeability set to one. E is total thermal, kinetic and magnetic energy density. Follow CT/GLM, divergence conventions and HLLD tests. Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 両法とも区分定数・同じ固定Rusanov速度α=3・前進Eulerです。CTは面Bと共有算術corner EMF、GLMはcell B/ψとch=3・物理減衰率κ=2を使用。全格子で同じ384刻み、両法のdt列も同一です。CT面平均から復元した初期cell BとGLM初期Bが一致します。
note.en: Both use piecewise constants, the same fixed Rusanov speed alpha3 and forward Euler. CT uses face B/shared arithmetic corner EMFs; GLM uses cell B/psi with fixed ch3 and physical damping rate kappa2. All meshes use384 steps and identical CT/GLM dt sequences; initial reconstructed CT cell B matches GLM cell B.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 主計算は固定α=ch=3のRusanovと前進Euler、GLMκ=2は格子に依存しません。独立C++ Athena++はHLLD・PLM・RK2・upwind CTです。同じ連続初期値を用いますが、Athenaのface/primitive離散化は主計算と完全同一ではありません。
note.en: Primary runs use fixed alpha=ch=3 Rusanov/forward Euler and grid-independent GLM kappa2. Independent C++ Athena++ uses HLLD/PLM/RK2/upwind CT. Continuous initial fields agree; Athena’s face/primitive discretization is not identical.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 同じ完全結合MHDコードを使用。y不変・By=vy=0ではGLMのBx/ψ系が流体応答から独立するため、離散Fourier記号の2×2行列と前進Euler行列冪を別に構成します。κ=2とκ=0を同じdt・LLF粘性で比較し、Bxだけの減少を物理減衰と取り違えません。
note.en: Use the same fully coupled MHD code. With y-invariance andBy=vy=0, the GLM Bx/psi subsystem decouples from fluid feedback, allowing a separately constructed2x2 discrete Fourier symbol and forward-Euler matrix power. Compare kappa2/0 at identical dt and LLF viscosity, separating B/psi phase exchange from physical damping.

note.ja: 構成厳密解の保存変数セル平均と格子誤差を比較します。固定した空間RHSを独立DOP853時間積分で解いた参照は時間誤差の確認用であり、別の空間ソルバーとは呼びません。18件の既存参照解ライブラリにはこの構成解のカードがないため、別問題の参照カードを流用せず、該当実行例の式・結果・ソースへ案内します。
note.en: Compare spatial errors against conserved cell averages of the constructed exact solution. Independent DOP853 integration of the same fixed spatial RHS checks temporal error and is not a separate spatial solver. The existing 18-case reference-solution library has no card for this constructed solution, so use the bound example’s equations, results and source rather than borrowing another problem’s reference card.

note.en: Measure conserved-variable L1/L2/Linf errors and observed orders at16²/32²/64². Compare finest-grid step doubling with.1 of the spatial error. At fixed8², compare16/32/64/128 steps with doubly refined DOP853 tolerances/max steps. Record mass/E, positivity, native CT divergence, common cell divergence and psi.

note.en: Measure density/magnetic L1 error, mesh improvement, positivity, conservation and div/psi. Athena256²/512² both useCFL.15; fixed512² CFL.3/.15 checks reference time sensitivity, with increments compared against.1 of primary error. At fixed16², compare primary time refinement with separately executed DOP853 and check finest-grid step doubling.

note.en: Check preservation of the initial CT defect, nonzero GLM psi, independent FE agreement for bothBx/psi, positive density/pressure, and conserved physical E/mass. Test the kappa2/0 ratio of auxiliary wave energy W=mean(Bx²+psi²/ch²), separating FE, semidiscrete-exponential and continuum-Fourier references.

通常の補助例CIはNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行する11グループです。独立ライブラリ等の保存参照は版と入力を記録した保存値に照合します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-models-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全5例を実行します。新規または空の出力先を指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元1変数、対称Gaussianランダムウォーク提案幅1.5。固定master seedから32の別PCG64ストリームを生成し、1024回のburn-in後に各8192標本を保持します。 採用した計算法 log受理比でMetropolis更新。FFTによる連鎖内自己共分散を平均し、Geyerのgamma0+gamma1から始まる初期正ペア和から平均観測量のESSを求めます。古典的split-Rhatも併記します。 text.en: MCMC, temperature control and biological models Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-models-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 5 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries One dimensionless variable and symmetric Gaussian random-walk width1.5. Spawn 32 separate PCG64 streams from a fixed master seed; retain 8192 samples per chain after 1024 burn-in steps. Adopted numerical method Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat. π(x)=(2π)−1/2e−x2/2,α=min⁡(1,e−(y2−x2)/2) τ=−1+2∑k=0K(ρ2k+ρ2k+1),Neff=MN/max⁡(1,τ) References and measured quantities Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs. Verification limits and failures Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Mass, Boltzmann constant, frequency, friction and temperature are one. Use 32768 replicas, burn time 20, steps 0.4/0.2/0.1 and correlation lag 2; require h*omega<2. Adopted numerical method Compose force B and drift A half steps with exact OU noise O in B-A-O-A-B order. Hamilton系・振動子

note.ja: 正準方程式と分離可能なHamiltonianの代表形。調和・4次ポテンシャルの振動子で、エネルギー誤差とシンプレクティック性を比べます。 Hamilton系へのリンクは調和ポテンシャルの力学部分です。計算には摩擦・雑音またはCSVRの温度浴が追加されます。
note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity. The Hamiltonian link identifies the harmonic mechanical part; the calculations add friction/noise or a CSVR heat bath.

name.ja: 熱・拡散方程式

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。 線形反応拡散u_t=D u_xx+r u（公開入力はD=0.1、r=0.1）です。熱方程式へのリンクは拡散部分で、反応項を含む固有値r-Dk²で比較します。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries. Linear reaction-diffusion u_t=D u_xx+r u, with published D=0.1 and r=0.1. The heat link covers diffusion; compare using the eigenvalue r-Dk² including reaction.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumoの興奮と回復

note.ja: 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 限定した実行例：公開実行例はD=0の空間なしの縮約ODEです。FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。 公開固定入力は空間拡散を含まない2変数ODEの極限です。一般の伝播PDEを検証したという意味ではありません。
note.en: A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction. The published fixed input is the two-variable ODE limit without spatial diffusion; it does not validate the general propagation PDE.

note.en: Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat.

note.ja: 線形反応拡散の連続Fourier解と半離散Fourier解を分け、空間2次・時間4次の収束を確認します。純拡散カードの指数率をそのまま使いません。
note.en: Separate continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions of linear reaction-diffusion to check second-order space/fourth-order time. Do not reuse the pure-diffusion card's decay rate unchanged.

name.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン：参照・比較条件
name.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 小振幅では行列指数の線形成長率を使い、非線形追補では独立Radau参照と正値性・収束を確認します。線形近似を非線形飽和パターンの厳密解と呼びません。
note.en: Use matrix-exponential linear growth rates at small amplitude; nonlinear supplements check independent Radau references, positivity and refinement. A linearization is not an exact saturated nonlinear pattern.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照：参照・比較条件
name.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 電流パルスを与えた2変数縮約ODEを独立DOP853参照と比較し、全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
note.en: Compare the two-variable reduced ODE under a current pulse with an independent DOP853 reference, checking all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery.

name.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS：参照・検証
name.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS — references and checks

note.ja: 正規CDFを独立参照とし、標本数1024/2048/8192の連鎖平均RMSEを比較。別の定常AR(1)系列と厳密tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho)で診断量を照合します。公差は固定入力で事前指定します。
note.en: Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs.

name.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関：参照・検証
name.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation — references and checks

note.ja: SciPy離散Lyapunov解および調和系の明示共分散diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4))で照合。運動量の刻み2次偏りと有限標本誤差を分離し、burn過渡を写像で評価。連続相関は別の行列指数で算出します。
note.en: Check against a SciPy discrete-Lyapunov solve and explicit harmonic covariance diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4)). Separate second-order momentum bias from sampling error and evaluate burn transients from the map. A separate matrix exponential gives continuous correlation.

name.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る：参照・検証
name.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time — references and checks

note.ja: 連続固有値r-Dk²への最大誤差で空間次数、半離散固有値r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx²への最大誤差で時間次数を測ります。独立した解析参照であり同じ実装の細格子値を参照にしません。
note.en: Measure spatial order against r-Dk² and temporal order against r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx². Both are independent analytic references, rather than a finer-grid run of the same solver.

name.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン：参照・検証
name.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns — references and checks

note.ja: 連続Fourier行列J-k²DのSciPy expmと線形数値解を比較し空間収束を測定。非線形計算は半離散線形行列指数との小振幅差を測り、成熟模様の参照照合とは区別します。
note.en: Compare linear numerical fields with SciPy expm of continuum J-k²D and measure spatial convergence. Quantify the nonlinear run against a semidiscrete linear matrix exponential as a small-amplitude check, not validation of mature morphology.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照：参照・検証
name.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference — references and checks

note.ja: 別実装SciPy DOP853のrtol1e-11と1e-13を比較して参照の感度を確認し、厳しい参照への最大解誤差と時間次数を評価します。ピーク時刻は出力格子上の精度です。
note.en: Compare separate SciPy DOP853 at rtol=1e-11 and 1e-13 to check reference sensitivity; measure maximum solution error and time order against the tighter reference. Peak time is resolved only on the output grid.

name.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS
name.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS

note.ja: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。
note.en: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence.

name.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関
name.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation

note.ja: 調和振動子のBAOABを、正準分布と離散Lyapunov定常分布、連続・離散の時間相関へ照合します。
note.en: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations.

name.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関
name.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes

note.ja: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。
note.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

name.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
name.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

note.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
note.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

name.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン
name.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

note.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
note.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

name.ja: Schnakenberg有限振幅過渡：非線形性と独立参照
name.en: Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference

note.ja: t=8までの有限振幅反応拡散を、独立なFourier–Galerkin参照・格子と時間刻み収束・新しい高調波で検証します。
note.en: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics.

name.ja: Schnakenberg飽和パターン：近定常性と格子・時間収束
name.en: Near-saturated Schnakenberg pattern: near-stationarity and grid/time convergence

note.ja: t=100の1D選択パターンを独立参照で照合。参照の90→100の変化・全PDE残差と、有限刻みprimaryのFD残差を分けて測ります。
note.en: Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual.

name.ja: 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する
name.en: Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input

note.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
note.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照
name.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference

note.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
note.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

title.ja: Noh衝撃波：厳密解・過熱誤差・格子収束
title.en: Noh shocks: exact reference, origin heating and refinement

ja.title: 配布版を取得して実行する
何と比較し、何を測るか
確認の限界と失敗条件
保存した実測値と判定
一次文献・関連資料と確認範囲

text.ja: Noh衝撃波：厳密解・過熱誤差・格子収束 初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称Noh問題を1D有限体積法で解きます。厳密セル平均・原点過熱・格子収束を比較し、球では離散保存と境界時間求積の誤差を別々に検証します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIはNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行する11グループです。独立ライブラリ等の保存参照は版と入力を記録した保存値に照合します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-noh-2026-11-23-r5 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。新規または空の出力先を指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元r∈[0,1]、γ=5/3、ρ0=1、u0=-1、p0=0、T=.6。平面d=1・円筒半径対称d=2・球半径対称d=3をPDE実行し、衝撃半径は.2。外側密度は(1+t)^(d-1)、原点は反射、体積測度r^(d-1)dr。角度因子をすべての収支から共通に省き、球の解析総量はM=512/375、E=256/375です。球の図は1D半径解の中心断面で、Cartesianの2D/3D計算や角度方向の対称性破れの検証ではありません。 編集上の補足 初回不合格の実行ソース・入力・全8格子計算の診断ログに加え、全8本の元の全場プロファイルCSVも保存しています。stdoutから原文のまま抽出した不合格サマリーの来歴とは区別します。旧r3の同じCSVとSHAが一致することを確認しました。公開する成功版は全断面CSV・履歴・結果とZIP独立展開の再実行記録を備えます。 採用した計算法 Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。 確認の限界と失敗条件 平面・円筒は空間一次、球はMUSCL型の制限線形再構築を使う教育用計算です。原点過熱と有限格子のplateau誤差が残り、全域誤差から原点を除外しません。r²重みで中心欠陥が小さく見えるため、原点を含む固定coreの誤差と拡大図も示します。L∞や中心最大誤差のゼロ収束、滑らかな球問題での方式全体の高次精度、幾何源付き全RK段階の一般の正値性保証、Cartesian多次元、任意γの独立照合は検証していません。円筒L∞は旧系列で単調減少せず、球のL2/L∞と過熱も診断値として保持します。球の離散質量・エネルギー収支が丸め誤差でも、解析総量との差は境界時間求積のO(dt²)となります。半径方向の運動量には幾何源があり、保存されるCartesian運動量とは異なります。ExactPackは解析評価器の独立実装で、別の数値PDEエンジンではありません。 text.en: Noh shocks: exact reference, origin heating and refinement Solve zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical Noh flow with 1D finite volumes. Compare exact cell means, origin heating and refinement; separately verify discrete budgets and boundary-time-quadrature error in spherical flow. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-noh-2026-11-23-r5 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional r in [0,1], gamma=5/3, rho0=1, u0=-1, p0=0, T=.6. PDE runs use planar d=1, cylindrical-radial d=2 and spherical-radial d=3, with shock radius .2. Outer density is (1+t)^(d-1), the origin reflects, and the measure is r^(d-1)dr. The same angular factor is omitted throughout; spherical analytic totals are M=512/375 and E=256/375. Its figure is a central section of a 1D radial solution, not a Cartesian 2D/3D calculation or a test of angular symmetry breaking. Editorial clarification The initial failed attempt retains its source, inputs, diagnostic logs and all eight original full-field profile CSVs. These arrays are distinct from the failed summary recovered verbatim from stdout; their hashes match the same CSVs in the prior r3 edition. The successful release supplies all profiles, histories, results and an independently extracted ZIP rerun. Adopted numerical method Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves. Verification limits and failures An educational calculation: first-order space in planar/cylindrical flow and MUSCL-type limited linear reconstruction in spherical flow. Origin heating and finite-grid plateau errors remain; the center is never removed from whole-domain error. Because r^2 weighting can make central defects appear small, an origin-inclusive fixed-core norm and enlarged view are also shown. Vanishing Linf/center maximum error, high order for the complete method on smooth spherical problems, general stage positivity with the geometric source, Cartesian multidimensional flow and independent arbitrary-gamma validation are not established. Cylindrical Linf was not monotone in the old series; spherical L2/Linf and heating are retained as diagnostics. Roundoff-scale discrete mass/energy balance coexists with O(dt^2) spherical boundary-time-quadrature error against analytic totals. Radial momentum has a geometric source and is not a conserved Cartesian momentum component. ExactPack independently implements the analytic evaluator, not another numerical PDE engine. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.ja: Rusanov／局所Lax–Friedrichs流束
Heun法／SSPRK(2,2)
MUSCL再構成
Minmod
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
note.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

text.en: Noh:2D Cartesian flow and grid orientation error A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-noh-cartesian-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional [-.5,.5]², gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0, T=.6, shock radius.2. Initial conserved states are cell-center cold samples, not exact initial momentum means. All four edges prescribe supersonic inflow rho=1+t/r and u=(-x/r,-y/r). No symmetry boundary, radial projection or geometric source. Adopted numerical method Unsplit shared-face x/y piecewise-constant Rusanov fluxes and SSPRK2/Heun. CFL .35 uses (max a_x+max a_y)/dx. Cold physical outer fluxes are spatially integrated analytically and their affine time dependence is integrated at both Heun stages. No cell repair, pressure floor/seed or hidden timestep retry; invalid stages retain raw arrays and fail. ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T rs=t/3,(ρ,p,ur)2=(16,16/3,0),(ρ,p,ur)1=(1+t/r,0,−1) ρˉi=1ΔxΔy∫Ciρexact(x2+y2,t) dx dy M(t)=4R2+8Rtasinh⁡(1)+πt2,Etot=M/2,R=0.5 Δt=0.35max⁡ax/Δx+max⁡ay/Δy References and measured quantities Inputs/source/acceptance hashes are saved before execution. All 19 unit tests and 49 gates on three grids passed at the first attempt. Analytic density is integrated over cells by splitting shock-circle cuts and 64-point Gauss quadrature with x=rs sin(theta), checked against 128 points and analytic total mass; these are quadrature references, not closed-form exact cell means. At 128², full-square density L1=.09981, origin-inclusive core L1=.12231; shock errors are.968 axis cells and1.469 diagonal cells. Maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about 4.6e-15. D4 conserved parity and continuous rotational symmetry are measured separately. Verification limits and failures A first-order-space lightweight example retains origin heating and shock errors. Finest maximum center specific internal energy is still about 14% high. Axis/diagonal shock-radius difference is about .501dx and is not monotone over these grids. Roundoff-level D4 parity does not establish exact circular symmetry. General perturbation stability, displaced origins, rotated meshes, 3D Cartesian flow and high-order accuracy are unverified. Earlier planar/cylindrical/spherical 1D editions and gates remain unchanged. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.en: Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation — references and checks

note.ja: 実行前に入力・ソース・受入基準をhash保存。19単体検査と3格子・49判定が初回から合格しました。解析密度のセル積分は衝撃円の交差で区間を分割し、x=rs sinθによる64点Gauss求積で評価、128点との差と全質量の解析式で確認します。閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。128²で密度全域L1=.09981、原点込みcore L1=.12231、衝撃位置は軸.968セル・対角1.469セルの誤差。離散収支の最大相対残差は約4.6e-15です。D4の鏡映・座標交換の保存量偶奇性と、連続回転対称性を区別して測ります。
note.en: Inputs/source/acceptance hashes are saved before execution. All 19 unit tests and 49 gates on three grids passed at the first attempt. Analytic density is integrated over cells by splitting shock-circle cuts and 64-point Gauss quadrature with x=rs sin(theta), checked against 128 points and analytic total mass; these are quadrature references, not closed-form exact cell means. At 128², full-square density L1=.09981, origin-inclusive core L1=.12231; shock errors are.968 axis cells and1.469 diagonal cells. Maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about 4.6e-15. D4 conserved parity and continuous rotational symmetry are measured separately.

name.ja: Nohの冷たい流入衝撃波：平面・円筒・球対称
name.en: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry

note.ja: 解析解 理想気体Euler、γ=5/3、初期密度1・内向き速度1・圧力0。r∈[0,1]、t=0.6。平面(d=1)・円筒半径対称(d=2)・球半径対称(d=3)の有限体積計算で、圧力の床は使いません。球のカラー図は1次元半径データの中心断面で、Cartesianの3次元計算ではありません。 別の実2D Cartesian版では[-.5,.5]²の32²/64²/128²格子、2成分運動量と両方向流束を使い、半径還元は行いません。密度参照は衝撃円で分割した64/128点の求積セル平均です。 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。
note.en: Analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128. Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p.

name.ja: Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算
name.en: Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow

note.ja: 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
note.en: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

name.ja: Noh問題：実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算
name.en: Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation

note.ja: 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。
note.en: A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array.

text.ja: 粒子・輸送：独立参照・保存則・統計誤差 周期力、FMM、PIC、衝突、放射輸送の既存問題を別版で検証します。決定論的な離散誤差、保存則、有限粒子数の偏りと統計誤差を分けます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIはNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行する11グループです。独立ライブラリ等の保存参照は版と入力を記録した保存値に照合します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-particle-transport-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全6例を実行します。新規または空の出力先を指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。 手法・式・図・参照解 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 Coulomb定数1、単位立方体の3次元周期、全電荷0、tin-foil境界。旧版と同じ非対称配置です。独立参照も同じ零モードと自己項の規約を使います。 編集上の補足 非対称な中性立方セルの全エネルギー・全24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較します。積分・打切り・上限の感度は、この固定配置での確認です。 採用した計算法 erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。 E=1π∫0∞[∑ijqiqjΘ(ri−rj,u)−∑iqi2]du Fi=−∇iE 何と比較し、何を測るか 参照の求積・theta/像の打切り・切替点をまとめて精密化し、上限32→40の感度を別に記録します。alpha3点、実空間4点・逆空間5点、平行移動・並べ替え、合力、エネルギー差分の3成分を比較。粗い打切りの不正確さを検出する対照も残します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 固定した中性立方セルだけです。上限感度は厳密な全配置の裾誤差保証ではありません。theta参照は別定式化の自作実装であり、第三者計算パッケージや公表された参照数表ではありません。非中性・非直交・スラブ・応力・長時間MDは対象外です。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / metric実測値 text.en: Particles and transport: independent references, conservation and statistical error Extend existing periodic-force, FMM, PIC, collision and radiation problems in a separate release. Separate deterministic discretization, conservation, finite-particle bias and statistical error. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-particle-transport-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 6 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Coulomb constant one; unit cubic 3D periodic neutral cell with tin-foil boundary. The asymmetric configuration matches the earlier example; reference zero-mode and self conventions match the model. Editorial clarification Compare the asymmetric neutral cubic-cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Quadrature, truncation and upper-tail sensitivity apply to this fixed configuration. Adopted numerical method Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces. E=1π∫0∞[∑ijqiqjΘ(ri−rj,u)−∑iqi2]du Fi=−∇iE References and measured quantities Record combined refinement of reference quadrature/theta/image/switch controls and a separate upper-limit 32-to-40 sensitivity. Compare three alpha values, four real and five reciprocal cutoffs, translation/permutation, net force and three energy-difference derivatives. Retain an intentionally inaccurate coarse-cutoff control. Verification limits and failures One fixed neutral cubic cell. Upper-limit sensitivity is not a rigorous tail bound for arbitrary configurations. The theta reference is an independently formulated original implementation, not an external package or published numerical table. Charged/triclinic/slab cells, stress and long MD are outside scope. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Same neutral periodic eight-charge cell, alpha=5.6 and three real-space image shells. This is Essmann-style SPME in the PME family, distinct from the original 1993 Lagrange interpolation. Editorial clarification Use the energy-gradient B-spline SPME variant of the PME family. Measure mesh-phase sensitivity and finite-mesh net force; do not claim exact momentum conservation or original Lagrange-PME reproduction. Adopted numerical method Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation. Fi=−∂Eh/∂ri ∑jMp(u−j)=1,∑jMp′(u−j)=0 References and measured quantities Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control. Verification limits and failures Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Length 2pi, stationary unit-density ions, electron q/m=−1, plasma frequency one, sinusoidal displacement 0.001 and final time 1.6. Mesh runs retain 2048 particles; time runs retain a 32-cell mesh and 256 particles. The particle weight is w=2pi/N and n is the grid count. Editorial clarification DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS and is independent only as a time algorithm. Separate quiet-start refinement from random-load noise at time zero; do not claim exact energy conservation. Adopted numerical method CIC deposition/matched gathering, spectral Poisson and velocity Verlet. The independent time algorithm DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS; compare its own maximum-step refinements. E[∣ρ^1/n∣2]=2+cos⁡(2π/n)3N Hh=w2∑ivi2+Δx2∑jEj2 References and measured quantities Refine 16/32/64 grids and dt=.2/.1/.05 separately; distinguish continuum cos(t) from time-reference errors. Record the real odd derivative’s Nyquist null mode separately from Gauss residuals. Compare time-zero CIC mode power at 64 seeds and N=256/1024/4096 with its analytic expectation. Verification limits and failures DOP853 is not an independent PIC spatial implementation. Distinguish charge/momentum preservation from approximate energy conservation. Initial-noise N scaling does not validate evolved warm plasmas. Landau damping, electromagnetic/relativistic PIC and collisions remain unvalidated. note.ja: erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。
note.en: Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces.

note.ja: 16³/24³/40³格子と4/6次Bスプライン、3つの平行移動位相を用います。FFT逆空間エネルギーを割当て重みで位置微分し、実空間・自己項はEwald主計算と共有します。
note.en: Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation.

note.ja: P2M/M2M/M2L/L2Lと近接P2Pを保ち、次数2/4/8/12、深さ2/3を比較します。別のCartesian直接和、二点電荷の閉形式、正多角形の中心力と遠方ポテンシャルを参照にします。
note.en: Retain P2M/M2M/M2L/L2L and near P2P; compare orders 2/4/8/12 and depths two/three. References include independent Cartesian direct sums, a closed-form charge pair and regular-polygon radial/far-field identities.

note.en: CIC deposition/matched gathering, spectral Poisson and velocity Verlet. The independent time algorithm DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS; compare its own maximum-step refinements.

note.ja: ランダムな完全対合と球面一様の散乱で、各対の運動量・エネルギーを保持します。別の標本生成ではGaussianを重心ゼロ部分空間へ射影し、半径を固定します。
note.en: Uniform random complete matchings and isotropic pair scattering preserve pair momentum/energy. An independent sampler projects Gaussian vectors into the zero-center-of-mass subspace and fixes their radius.

note.ja: 1次風上有限体積の空間更新とGauss–Legendre方向を使い、角度系列は正確な指数伝播で空間誤差を除きます。MCはmu=sqrt(U)と指数光学距離から生存・吸収を独立に判定します。
note.en: Use upstream finite volumes and Gauss-Legendre ordinates; exact exponential propagation removes spatial error in the angle series. Monte Carlo independently tracks survival/absorption using mu=sqrt(U) and exponential optical paths.

note.ja: 参照の求積・theta/像の打切り・切替点をまとめて精密化し、上限32→40の感度を別に記録します。alpha3点、実空間4点・逆空間5点、平行移動・並べ替え、合力、エネルギー差分の3成分を比較。粗い打切りの不正確さを検出する対照も残します。
note.en: Record combined refinement of reference quadrature/theta/image/switch controls and a separate upper-limit 32-to-40 sensitivity. Compare three alpha values, four real and five reciprocal cutoffs, translation/permutation, net force and three energy-difference derivatives. Retain an intentionally inaccurate coarse-cutoff control.

note.ja: 独立thetaエネルギー・全力との差と、共有Ewald経路自体の誤差を明記します。分配の総和・導関数総和、電荷、エネルギー差分3成分、位相間の幅、有限格子の合力と粗い格子の対照を保存します。
note.en: Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control.

note.ja: ポテンシャル・場の最大絶対誤差、実際の遠方移動演算、回転・平行移動誤差、電荷を掛けた力の合計を測ります。粗い展開の失敗対照も確認します。
note.en: Measure maximum absolute potential/field errors, actual far translations, rotation/translation differences and net charge-weighted force. Detect an inaccurate low-order control.

name.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音：参照・検証
name.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise — references and checks

note.ja: 16/32/64格子とdt=.2/.1/.05を別に精密化し、線形cos(t)と時間参照の誤差を分離します。実数奇微分のNyquist零モードはGauss残差から分けて記録。時刻0の64seed・N=256/1024/4096のCICモード電力を解析期待値と比較します。
note.en: Refine 16/32/64 grids and dt=.2/.1/.05 separately; distinguish continuum cos(t) from time-reference errors. Record the real odd derivative’s Nyquist null mode separately from Gauss residuals. Compare time-zero CIC mode power at 64 seeds and N=256/1024/4096 with its analytic expectation.

name.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差：参照・検証

note.ja: 全roundの運動量・エネルギーの最大保存誤差は決定論的な許容値で検査します。最初の6roundの異方性、4点のエネルギーCDF、4次モーメントと有限NのBeta参照との差は、独立seed間の標準誤差で測ります。NによるCDF標準誤差の減少と、有限NからMaxwellへの偏りを分けます。
note.en: Check maximum momentum/energy errors over all rounds against deterministic tolerances. Use independent-seed standard errors for six-round anisotropy, four energy-CDF points and fourth moments against the finite-N beta reference. Separate decreasing CDF sampling error with N from finite-N Maxwell bias.

name.ja: 放射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計：参照・検証
name.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics — references and checks

note.ja: 16〜256セル・4〜64方向を別に収束させ、QUADPACK積分とE3を照合。64seed・1024/4096/16384光子で平均誤差、RMSE、二項標準偏差と95% Clopper–Pearson区間の実測被覆を記録します。全光子の出射＋吸収、正値性と離散フラックス収支を確認します。
note.en: Refine 16–256 cells and 4–64 ordinates separately; compare QUADPACK integration with E3. For 64 seeds and 1024/4096/16384 photons, record mean error, RMSE, binomial standard deviation and observed 95% Clopper–Pearson coverage. Check photon exit-plus-absorption counts, positivity and discrete flux balance.

name.ja: Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分
name.en: Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration

note.ja: 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。
note.en: Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation.

name.ja: SPME：格子・補間次数・格子位相と保存則
name.en: SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation

note.ja: BスプラインSPMEを同じ独立theta参照へ照合し、格子・次数・位相への依存、電荷の保持、エネルギー勾配と合力を測ります。
note.en: Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force.

name.ja: FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ
name.en: FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth

note.ja: 96粒子の2次元対数核を別の全対直接和と照合し、展開次数・木の深さ、回転・平行移動、合力の近似誤差を測ります。
note.en: Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors.

name.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音
name.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise

note.ja: 冷たい1次元周期プラズマのquiet-start収束と、独立seedでの初期粒子雑音を分け、電荷・運動量・Gauss則・エネルギー誤差を保存します。
note.en: Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error.

name.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差
name.en: DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error

note.ja: 有限粒子数の平衡をMaxwell極限と区別し、独立な球面標本、解析的異方性減衰、seed間誤差と比較します。
note.en: Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty.

name.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics

note.ja: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。
note.en: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage.

text.en: Particles, electrostatics, kinetic and radiative transport Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-particles-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 6 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Cubic cell, zero total charge, Coulomb constant one and conducting/tin-foil boundary. An asymmetric eight-charge case is distinct from the eight-ion NaCl reference cell. Adopted numerical method Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences. Mesh/order convergence of B-spline smooth PME A small smooth-PME example assigns charge with B-splines and evaluates the Ewald reciprocal contribution by FFT. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation. Adopted numerical method Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces. Adopted numerical method Combine CIC deposition and matching field gathering, a mean-zero spectral Poisson solve and velocity Verlet. name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: erfcで減衰する実空間和、Gaussian係数を持つ構造因子の逆格子和、−alpha/sqrt(pi) sum(q²)を加えます。力は各項の位置微分から求め、24成分を中心エネルギー差分と比較します。
note.en: Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 4次または6次のcardinal Bスプラインのテンソル積で電荷を格子化し、節点スプラインの離散構造因子補正、Gaussian Green関数、3次元FFTを組み合わせます。格子エネルギーを重みの位置微分で解析的に微分します。
note.en: Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 葉でP2M、上向きのM2M、相互作用リスト上のM2L、下向きのL2L、局所多項式の評価と近接P2Pを実装します。遠方を粒子ごとに開くBarnes–Hutへ置き換えず、移動演算回数と近接対数を記録します。
note.en: Implement leaf P2M, upward M2M, interaction-list M2L, downward L2L, local-polynomial evaluation and near-field P2P. Record translation and near-pair counts; this is not a Barnes–Hut traversal relabeled as FMM.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: CIC電荷割当てと同じ重みの場補間、ゼロ平均のスペクトルPoisson解、速度Verletを組み合わせます。実数の奇微分の規約により、電場のNyquistモードはゼロにします。
note.en: Combine CIC deposition and matching field gathering, a mean-zero spectral Poisson solve and velocity Verlet. Set the field Nyquist mode to zero for a real skew-adjoint spectral derivative.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
note.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 正のGauss–Legendre離散方向と1次風上有限体積の空間行進を使います。角度誤差だけを分ける系列では、一定セル内を指数関数で正確に伝播します。
note.en: Use positive Gauss–Legendre ordinates and first-order upstream finite-volume marching. A separate angular-error sweep uses exact exponential propagation within each constant cell.

name.ja: 中性周期点電荷：Ewald・smooth PME：参照・比較条件
name.en: Neutral periodic charges: Ewald and smooth PME — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 同じ中性周期電荷・規約の収束したEwald和、力の有限差分とカットオフ・格子収束を確認します。孤立重力粒子の直接和とは境界・相互作用が異なります。 追加版は同じ中性8点電荷・立方体・tin-foil規約のエネルギーと全粒子力を、別実装theta積分と参照自身の細分化に照合します。SPMEはB-splineのエネルギー勾配型であり、原Lagrange PMEや厳密運動量保存を主張しません。
note.en: Check converged Ewald sums for identical neutral periodic charges/conventions, force finite differences and cutoff/mesh refinement. Boundaries and interactions differ from isolated gravitational direct sums. The companion compares energy and every force for the same neutral eight-charge cubic tin-foil cell against a separately implemented theta integral and its own refinement. SPME uses B-spline energy gradients; original Lagrange PME and exact momentum conservation are not claimed.

name.ja: 2次元対数核のM2M・M2L・L2Lを持つFMM：参照・比較条件
name.en: 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 同じ2次元対数核と粒子配置の直接和を数値基準に、多重極の次数・階層変換・力誤差を確認します。3次元1/r核の基準は流用しません。 追加版ではCartesian直接和と解析配置を別の基準にし、展開次数と木深さを分離します。深さに対する単調収束や3次元Coulomb核の精度・計算量を保証しません。
note.en: Use direct summation with the same 2D logarithmic kernel and particles to check expansion order, hierarchical translations and force error. Do not reuse a 3D 1/r reference. The companion uses Cartesian direct sums and analytic configurations as separate references, varying expansion order and tree depth independently. It guarantees neither monotonic error with depth nor accuracy/complexity for a 3D Coulomb kernel.

name.ja: CIC静電PICの冷たいプラズマ振動：参照・比較条件
name.en: Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 小振幅の冷たいプラズマの線形変位cos(t)と比較し、電荷整合性・Poisson残差・自己力、格子系列と時間刻み系列を確認します。一般の非線形PIC軌道の厳密解という主張ではありません。 追加版は静止イオン背景のまま、電荷・運動量・粒子と場のエネルギーを軌道誤差と分けます。小振幅線形参照であり、熱的Landau減衰や電磁PICの根拠ではありません。
note.en: Compare with linear cold-plasma displacement cos(t); check charge compatibility, Poisson residual, self force, and separate grid/timestep series. This is not an exact reference for general nonlinear PIC trajectories. The companion retains stationary background ions and separates charge, momentum and particle/field-energy diagnostics from trajectory error. Its reference is small-amplitude linear theory, supplying no evidence for thermal Landau damping or electromagnetic PIC.

name.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布：参照・比較条件
name.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 等質衝突成分の運動量・エネルギー保存、異方性緩和と分布モーメントを確認します。有限粒子数の平衡はmicrocanonicalで、Maxwell/Gamma分布は大粒子数極限の基準です。空間輸送を含むBoltzmann方程式全体の厳密解検証ではありません。 追加版は固定運動量・エネルギー球面の有限粒子数モーメントを導出し、独立な射影正規標本と複数seedで比較します。衝突roundは物理時間ではなく、hard-sphere空間輸送へ対応を広げません。
note.en: Check momentum/energy conservation, anisotropy relaxation and distribution moments for the homogeneous collision component. Finite-particle equilibrium is microcanonical; Maxwell/Gamma distributions are large-N standards. This does not validate an exact solution of the full spatial Boltzmann equation. The companion derives finite-particle moments on a fixed-momentum/energy sphere and compares independent projected-Gaussian samples across seeds. Collision rounds are not physical time, and the correspondence does not extend to spatial hard-sphere transport.

name.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標放射輸送：参照・比較条件
name.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 純吸収・指定流入の平板に対する各方向の解析的な指数減衰と離散座標解を比較します。相対論的M1モーメント閉包とは別の放射モデルです。 追加版は解析rayと連続角度参照を保持し、固定角度の空間誤差と厳密rayの角度誤差、流入・流出・体積吸収の収支を分けます。散乱や多次元閉包へ拡張しません。
note.en: Compare discrete ordinates with analytic directional exponential attenuation through a purely absorbing slab with specified inflow. This differs from relativistic M1 moment closure. The companion retains analytic rays and a continuum-angle reference, separating fixed-ordinate spatial error, exact-ray angular error and inflow/outflow/volume-absorption balance. It does not extend to scattering or multidimensional closures.

name.ja: 中性周期セルのEwald和と独立theta積分：参照・検証
name.en: Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral — references and checks

note.ja: 分割alphaを3点、実空間打切りを3点、逆空間打切りを4点で確認。NaClのMadelung定数は3次元和を呼ばない独立な1次元Jacobi-theta積分と照合し、求積の誤差推定も保存します。
note.en: Three splitting parameters, three real cutoffs and four reciprocal cutoffs. Check the NaCl Madelung constant against a separately implemented 1D Jacobi-theta integral, storing its quadrature error estimate.

name.ja: Bスプラインsmooth PMEの格子・次数収束：参照・検証

note.ja: 16³・24³・40³格子と2つの次数で、直接Ewald逆空間和との差を記録します。Ewaldと実空間項・自己項を共有する部分も明示。最細格子の力はエネルギー差分とも比較し、全電荷の保持を確認します。
note.en: Meshes 16³/24³/40³ and two orders are compared with directly summed Ewald reciprocal terms. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge.

name.ja: 2次元対数核のM2M・M2L・L2Lを持つFMM：参照・検証

note.ja: 固定seedの128粒子で次数2・4・8・12を走査し、別の全対直接和とポテンシャル・電場の全成分を照合します。2点の符号、順序不変性、ポテンシャル微分も検査します。
note.en: For 128 fixed-seed particles, sweep orders 2/4/8/12 and compare every potential/field component with a separate all-pairs calculation. Also check two-source signs, permutation invariance and potential derivatives.

note.ja: 32・64・128格子の系列と、別の512格子上の時間刻み系列を分けます。変位モードを連続線形理論のcos(t)と比較し、全電荷・Poissonポテンシャル残差・単一粒子の自己力を検査します。
note.en: Separate a 32/64/128-grid sweep from timestep refinement on a 512 grid. Compare displacement amplitude with continuum linear cos(t), and check charge compatibility, potential-Poisson residual and single-particle self force.

name.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布：参照・検証
name.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component — references and checks

note.ja: 粒子512・2048・8192、16 seedで、運動量・運動エネルギー、Maxwellの2次/4次モーメント、Gamma(3/2,1)のエネルギーCDFを比較。異方性の期待減衰率(N−2)/(2(N−1))も独立に照合します。 有限Nの成分4次モーメントは3−6/(3N−1)であり、Maxwell値3との有限N偏りとseed間の標本誤差を区別します。
note.en: Use 512/2048/8192 particles and sixteen seeds to check momentum/energy, Maxwell second/fourth moments and the Gamma(3/2,1) energy CDF. Independently check the expected per-round anisotropy factor (N−2)/(2(N−1)). The finite-N component fourth moment is 3−6/(3N−1); distinguish that finite-particle offset from the across-seed sampling uncertainty.

title.ja: Sedov–Taylor点爆発：球対称の軽量検証
title.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation

ja.title: 配布版を取得して実行する
何と比較し、何を測るか
確認の限界と失敗条件
保存した実測値と判定
一次文献・関連資料と確認範囲

text.ja: Sedov–Taylor点爆発：球対称の軽量検証 球対称Euler方程式を半径方向の有限体積法で解く軽量例です。固定した半径0.03の領域に総エネルギー1を与え、128・256・512セルで点爆発の相似参照からの差と保存収支を測ります。図は1次元球対称データの断面表示で、2次元Cartesian計算ではありません。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIはNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行する11グループです。独立ライブラリ等の保存参照は版と入力を記録した保存値に照合します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-sedov-2026-11-23-r2 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。新規または空の出力先を指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Sedov–Taylor点爆発：球対称の軽量検証 球対称Euler方程式を半径方向の有限体積法で解く軽量例です。固定した半径0.03の領域に総エネルギー1を与え、128・256・512セルで点爆発の相似参照からの差と保存収支を測ります。図は1次元球対称データの断面表示で、2次元Cartesian計算ではありません。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元、γ=5/3、初期密度1・速度0・背景圧力0、半径[0,1]、総注入エネルギー1、T=.05。球内一様の熱エネルギーを各殻の切断体積で正確に配分します。注入半径0.03を3格子で共通にし、512セルでは半径0.015の別実行も保存します。原点は鏡映、外端は流出境界で、実際の境界流束を収支へ含めます。 編集上の補足 初版r1はMacで22検査・4計算が合格しましたが、公開ZIPのLinux追試では22検査の後、-Werror付き本計算で冷たい裾の極小波速に対するCFL候補比がoverflow警告となり失敗しました。r2は同じCFL条件を1/max(波速/幅)で計算して中間overflowを回避します。入力・受入閾値は変更せず、旧版・失敗記録を保持して23検査と全固定入力を新しいZIPで再実行しました。固定投入半径で点源参照と比べる誤差にはモデル差も含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間精度次数ではありません。投入半径の比較は感度診断であり、投入モデルとPDE離散化誤差の完全分離ではありません。 初版Linux失敗記録: https://github.com/hrkoyama/hrkoyama.github.io/actions/runs/45109504662 （22検査は合格、最初の128セル・投入半径.03の本計算でRuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in divide）。 採用した計算法 球殻体積と面積を用いる区分定数Rusanov流束＋SSPRK2（Heun）です。半径運動量の幾何源p(A右−A左)/Vを同じRK段で積分し、静止した一様圧力との釣り合いも検査します。CFL=.4はmax((|u|+c)/(V/(A左+A右)))の逆数を使い、残り時間との比較を先に行います。圧力seed・floor・セル平均修復・隠れた刻み再試行はなく、不正な段は生の保存量と履歴を保存して失敗とします。 text.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-sedov-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional gamma=5/3, ambient density1, velocity0, pressure0, radius[0,1], deposited energy1, T=.05. Uniform thermal energy inside a sphere is assigned using exact cut-shell volumes. Deposition radius0.03 is shared by all three grids; a separate512-cell run uses0.015. The origin is reflecting and the outer boundary is outflow; actual boundary fluxes enter measured budgets. Editorial clarification Revisionr1 passed22 tests and four runs on Mac, but its public-ZIP Linux retry passed22 tests then failed in the -Werror main run when a CFL candidate ratio overflowed at tiny cold-tail wave speeds. Revisionr2 evaluates the same CFL condition as1/max(speed/width), avoiding intermediate overflow. Inputs/acceptance thresholds stay unchanged; retain the old release/failure and independently rerun23 tests and all fixed inputs from a new ZIP. Fixed-radius point-source comparison includes model discrepancy: its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order, and the radius comparison is sensitivity rather than complete deposition/PDE-error separation. Original Linux failure: https://github.com/hrkoyama/hrkoyama.github.io/actions/runs/45109504662 (all22 tests passed; the first128-cell,rdep.03 main calculation raised RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in divide before completion). Adopted numerical method Piecewise-constant Rusanov fluxes on spherical shells with SSPRK2/Heun. The radial-momentum source p(A_right-A_left)/V is integrated at the same RK stages, with a stationary uniform-pressure balance test. CFL.4 uses the reciprocal maximum (|u|+c)/(V/(A_left+A_right)), comparing with the remaining interval before division. No pressure seed, floor, cell repair or hidden timestep retry; an invalid stage retains raw conserved values and history and fails. ∂tU+1r2∂r(r2F)=(0,2p/r,0)T,U=(ρ,ρu,E)T Rs(t)=β(E0t2/ρ0)1/5,β≃1.15166641793,R˙s=2Rs/(5t) ρ=ρ0G(ξ),u=R˙sV(ξ),p=ρ0R˙s2P(ξ),ξ=r/Rs E0=4π∫0∞(pγ−1+ρu22)r2 dr=1 Uˉi=3ri+1/23−ri−1/23∫ri−1/2ri+1/2U(r)r2 dr References and measured quantities Original r1 passed22 tests and48 gates on Mac, but its public-ZIP Linux run failed when warnings-as-errors raised a cold-tail CFL overflow. Revision r2 uses the algebraically equivalent reciprocal maximum-rate evaluation while preserving the original inputs, reference and48 acceptance gates. A new r2-specific pre-execution hash contract precedes23 tests and all four calculations/48 gates passing with warnings as errors. Original sources, contract and actual Linux-failure evidence remain archived. The independent reference integrates the similarity ODE with DOP853, normalizes energy, uses a regular asymptote for xi<.001 and split shell quadrature at the shock. Orders16/32, core cutoff and ODE tolerance are checked separately. The unmodified pinned ExactPack evaluator was independently run at6001/12001 points and compared away from the center/jump with its preregistered5e-4 criterion. Beta=1.15166641793, Rs(.05)=.34746791233. Origin/shock-inclusive volume-weighted density L1 within r<=1.2Rs is.17257/.12785/.07458 and pressure L1 is.18148/.13939/.07615. Finest shock error is1.096 cells; maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about8.89e-16. Verification limits and failures A finite deposition sphere and an ideal point blast have different initial data; reported errors combine deposition-model and discretization effects. The refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Halving the source radius at the same512 cells changes density by about.000451 and pressure by.000619, but point-reference errors become slightly worse; no improvement or point-source-limit proof is claimed. Pressure compares numerical p(mean conserved U) with reference mean physical pressure, distinct from p(mean reference U). Center values and maximum errors remain reported. The finest density peak is about2.918 versus the exact jump4. The cold-tail local-CFL overflow that caused the r1 Linux failure is avoided in r2 by the equivalent maximum inverse-rate evaluation, without suppressing warnings or adding a physical floor. The regular tiny-core continuation is approximate, and ExactPack point probes exclude xi<.15. Cartesian2D/3D, general perturbations/asymmetry and high-order accuracy are unverified. note.ja: 初版r1はMacで22単体検査・48判定が合格しましたが、公開ZIPのLinux追試では警告を例外にする設定でCFL比のoverflowにより失敗しました。r2は代数的に等価な逆数最大率へ評価順を変更し、元の入力・参照・受入基準48条件を維持。r2専用の実行前hash契約を保存してから、警告を例外にした23検査と全4計算・48判定が合格しました。初版のソース・契約・Linux失敗記録も保存しています。参照は独立な相似ODEのDOP853積分、エネルギー規格化、中心ξ<.001の正則漸近形と衝撃位置で分割する殻求積です。16/32点求積・中心cutoff/ODE公差を別々に確認。固定commitの未改変ExactPackを6001/12001点で別実行し、中心とジャンプから離れた点を事前基準5e-4で照合しました。β=1.15166641793、Rs(.05)=.34746791233。原点・衝撃波を含むr≤1.2Rsの体積重み密度L1は.17257/.12785/.07458、圧力L1は.18148/.13939/.07615。512セルの衝撃位置誤差は1.096セル、最大離散収支残差は約8.89e-16です。
note.en: Original r1 passed22 tests and48 gates on Mac, but its public-ZIP Linux run failed when warnings-as-errors raised a cold-tail CFL overflow. Revision r2 uses the algebraically equivalent reciprocal maximum-rate evaluation while preserving the original inputs, reference and48 acceptance gates. A new r2-specific pre-execution hash contract precedes23 tests and all four calculations/48 gates passing with warnings as errors. Original sources, contract and actual Linux-failure evidence remain archived. The independent reference integrates the similarity ODE with DOP853, normalizes energy, uses a regular asymptote for xi<.001 and split shell quadrature at the shock. Orders16/32, core cutoff and ODE tolerance are checked separately. The unmodified pinned ExactPack evaluator was independently run at6001/12001 points and compared away from the center/jump with its preregistered5e-4 criterion. Beta=1.15166641793, Rs(.05)=.34746791233. Origin/shock-inclusive volume-weighted density L1 within r<=1.2Rs is.17257/.12785/.07458 and pressure L1 is.18148/.13939/.07615. Finest shock error is1.096 cells; maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about8.89e-16.

text.ja: 作用素分割：同じ反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較 短い時間区間の非線形Schnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ初期場・格子・部分ソルバー・出力時刻で比較します。時間の収束と数値参照の感度を調べる軽量な追加例です。既存の空間収束・長時間パターンの記録は保持します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIはNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行する11グループです。独立ライブラリ等の保存参照は版と入力を記録した保存値に照合します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-splitting-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。新規または空の出力先を指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
