text.en: Explore small implemented validations by field These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Check each case’s assumptions, adopted variant, independent/analytic reference, residuals, refinement and failure handling. These supplements are separate from the shared 22 execution registry. Detailed quantum-DFT sweeps are outside routine lightweight checks. Routine supplement CI runs eleven NumPy/SciPy/pytest groups, comparing stored independent-library references with versioned, input-traced stored values. The existing common 22-case suite, including quantum convergence, remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts, criteria and history are preserved. 44 fixed validation cases are runnable through 15 supplements. AMG, factorizations, eigenvalues and quadrature 29 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. Methods, equations, figures and references Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions. Methods, equations, figures and references Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references. Methods, equations, figures and references Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK. Methods, equations, figures and references MCMC, temperature control and biological models 26 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence. Methods, equations, figures and references Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations. Methods, equations, figures and references Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions. Methods, equations, figures and references Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode. Methods, equations, figures and references FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853. Methods, equations, figures and references Particles, electrostatics, kinetic and radiative transport 27 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs. Methods, equations, figures and references Mesh/order convergence of B-spline smooth PME A small smooth-PME example assigns charge with B-splines and evaluates the Ewald reciprocal contribution by FFT. Methods, equations, figures and references 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L Evaluate a free-space log potential with uniform-quadtree multipole and local expansions and compare with direct sums. Methods, equations, figures and references Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC Couple electrons to a 1D periodic grid by CIC, solving Poisson and particle motion self-consistently. Methods, equations, figures and references Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules. Methods, equations, figures and references Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux. Methods, equations, figures and references Independent fluid/MHD comparisons and CT/GLM 11 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++ Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. Methods, equations, figures and references Brio–Wu against an independent HLLD implementation Compare the published HLLD-MC finite-volume code with Brio–Wu reference data independently produced by Athena++ at a pinned commit. Methods, equations, figures and references Shu–Osher: independent reference and mesh refinement Compare shock–density-wave interaction against separately executed Athena++ reference data rather than a finer grid of the same Python code. Methods, equations, figures and references GLM longitudinal mode: analytic damping Compare a longitudinal magnetic Fourier mode of GLM cleaning with the continuous linear matrix-exponential solution. Methods, equations, figures and references CSVR and Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations 42 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations. Methods, equations, figures and references CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Methods, equations, figures and references Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references. Methods, equations, figures and references Independent validation of nonlinear reaction–diffusion and pattern formation 28 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics. Methods, equations, figures and references Near-saturated Schnakenberg pattern: near-stationarity and grid/time convergence Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual. Methods, equations, figures and references Multimodal MCMC: independent checks of poor mixing and convergence diagnostics 39 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration. Methods, equations, figures and references Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies Actually process62 byte-identical datasets with separately installed ArviZ0.20.0, bound by recipe/input/chain/official-source hashes. Separate finite-value agreement from explicit degeneracy-policy differences. Methods, equations, figures and references CT and GLM: matched controls, independent checks and grid/time convergence 46 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Methods, equations, figures and references Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Methods, equations, figures and references Initial-constraint preservation by CT and active GLM cleaning: nonphysical control Intentionally begin with the same non-solenoidal cell B, checking that CT does not remove the initial defect and calibrating GLM’s B/psi response. This diagnostic adds no physical problem. Methods, equations, figures and references Numerical foundations: conditioning, residuals, convergence and independent references 49 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error. Methods, equations, figures and references QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs. Methods, equations, figures and references Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace. Methods, equations, figures and references Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK. Methods, equations, figures and references Particles and transport: independent references, conservation and statistical error 75 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation. Methods, equations, figures and references SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force. Methods, equations, figures and references FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors. Methods, equations, figures and references PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error. Methods, equations, figures and references DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty. Methods, equations, figures and references Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage. Methods, equations, figures and references Operator splitting: Lie–Trotter and Strang on the same reaction–diffusion problem 16 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison. Methods, equations, figures and references Noh shocks: exact reference, origin heating and refinement 28 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity. Methods, equations, figures and references Noh:2D Cartesian flow and grid orientation error 19 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array. Methods, equations, figures and references Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation 23 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation. Methods, equations, figures and references Double Mach reflection: lightweight grid verification 21 tests passed; every input rerun from an independent ZIP extraction. Double Mach reflection: lightweight grid verification Full 2D Euler finite volumes evolve the existing Double Mach initial/boundary data to T=.2 on64x16,128x32 and256x64 cells. Compare a separately written finite-grid reference, actual boundary-flux budgets, an upper incident-front position and a fixed near-wall region. Methods, equations, figures and references Original code is MIT. Text, figures, fixed inputs, numerical data and third-party material retain their separate terms. LICENSING.md · Rights & AI policy

CIP：値と勾配を運ぶ 非圧縮流：整合する離散演算子で射影する MHD：制約輸送法と発散クリーニング 相対論的流体力学：SRHD、GRHD、GRMHD 流体・MHDの独立照合とCT／GLM CTとGLM：同条件の独立照合・格子・時間収束 粒子・運動論・輸送 粒子法、分布関数、長距離力と輸送方程式を読みます。 粒子法と平滑化粒子流体力学 Godunov平滑化粒子流体力学（GSPH） text.en: Learn by field Read the theory, derivations and worked examples by field, from foundations to related methods and verification. Look up a method’s conditions, code and checks: Methods and code reference Foundations, error and time integration Start with error and stability, then follow time integration and equations with constraints. Differences, CFL, von Neumann analysis, and Lax A-stability, L-stability and error norms Time integration and leapfrog Runge–Kutta families: stages, order, stability, and SSP Stiff integration: solve the stage, control the time error Operator splitting: Lie–Trotter and Strang Operator splitting: Lie–Trotter and Strang on the same reaction–diffusion problem Symplectic integration: a canonical map, not an exact energy promise Differential-algebraic equations / DAE Elliptic problems, linear algebra and approximation Go from boundary-value problems and sparse solvers to eigenvalues, basis functions, interpolation and quadrature. Diffusion, elliptic equations, boundary conditions, and iteration Nishikawa's hyperbolic diffusion: iterate a first-order system Sparse and nonlinear systems: measure the actual residual Algebraic multigrid / AMG QR, SVD and least squares Krylov eigenvalue solvers Orthogonal polynomials and mesh basis functions Spline interpolation Gaussian and adaptive quadrature Chebyshev approximation Wavelets AMG, factorizations, eigenvalues and quadrature Numerical foundations: conditioning, residuals, convergence and independent references Differentiation, optimization and inverse problems Distinguish derivatives of residuals and solutions, then connect objectives, observations and regularization. Automatic differentiation: derivatives for numerical solvers Implicit differentiation and adjoints: Bratu parameter sensitivity Gradient and quasi-Newton optimization Bratu inverse problem: estimate λ from synthetic observations with adjoint gradients Multi-parameter Bratu inversion: regularization and identifiability PINNs and neural operators Fluids, shocks and steady solvers Read about reconstruction, limiting and shock robustness, followed by low-Mach conditions and steady iterations. Euler reconstruction: PPM, characteristics, WENO-Z and AUSM Slope limiters: minmod, Superbee, MC, van Leer, and van Albada Advanced limiters: TVB and positivity preservation Rotated-hybrid Riemann solver Traced PPM, AUSM variants and curved bow shocks The carbuncle phenomenon Double Mach Reflection Double Mach reflection: lightweight grid verification KEEP schemes: preserve the smooth-flow balance, test the limits Preconditioning, dual time stepping, and residual distribution Preconditioning matrices, low Mach numbers, sonic points and entropy fixes Damping Runge–Kutta iterations for steady solutions NASA 2D verification and validation case catalog Noh shocks: exact reference, origin heating and refinement Noh:2D Cartesian flow and grid orientation error Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation Meshes, finite elements and coupled equations Organize spatial discretization and coordinates, then examine incompressible flow, MHD and relativistic systems. Structured, unstructured, and triangular meshes Continuous finite elements: from weak form to sparse assembly Arbitrary Lagrangian–Eulerian methods Polar and cylindrical coordinates: tensors and viscosity Spherical meshes and Arakawa A, B and C grids CIP: carry the value and the gradient Incompressible flow: project with compatible discrete operators MHD: constrained transport and divergence cleaning Relativistic hydrodynamics: SRHD, GRHD, and GRMHD Independent fluid/MHD comparisons and CT/GLM CT and GLM: matched controls, independent checks and grid/time convergence Particles, kinetic methods and transport Explore particle methods, distribution functions, long-range forces and transport equations. title.ja: DFT → 第一原理MD → 温度制御

keywords: 静的な電子状態から核の力、軌道、熱浴へ。固定Heの力と、別の古典系でのLangevin／CSVRの分布・揺らぎ・相関をたどり、第一原理MDとの連成に残る検証を確かめます。

Move from static electronic structure to nuclear forces, trajectories and a heat bath. Follow fixed-He forces and separate classical Langevin/CSVR distribution, fluctuation and correlation checks, then inspect the remaining first-principles-MD coupling requirements.
非線形反復・自己無撞着性
SCFや陰的反応更新では残差を減らす反復が必要になる。小さな代数残差、離散化の収束、物理モデルの妥当性を分ける。
SCF and implicit reaction updates require iterative residual reduction. Separate algebraic residuals, discretization convergence and physical-model validity.
固有値・安定性・分散関係
固有値はKS軌道、反応平衡の安定性、拡散モードの減衰などに現れる。同じ固有値計算でも、固有値の物理的意味と検証する量は異なる。
Eigenvalues describe KS orbitals, reaction-equilibrium stability and diffusion-mode decay. Their physical interpretation and validation targets differ even when the algebra overlaps.
時間発展・演算子の分割
核の運動、反応、移流、拡散はいずれも離散化後の時間積分へつながる。安定性、剛性、保存量と分割誤差は対象ごとに確認する。
Nuclear motion, reactions, advection and diffusion lead to time integration after discretization. Stability, stiffness, balances and splitting error require problem-specific checks.
確率分布・揺らぎ・標本化
熱浴やMCMCでは平均だけでなく分布・相関・有限標本誤差を調べます。不変密度の式、R-hat≈1、大きなESSだけでは有限時間の探索や輸送特性は保証されません。MCMCの診断対照をMDや熱浴の連成検証へ流用しません。

Thermostats and MCMC require distributions, correlations and finite-sample uncertainty as well as means. Invariant-density formulas, R-hat near one or large ESS do not guarantee finite-time exploration or transport properties. MCMC diagnostic controls do not establish MD/thermostat coupling.

name.ja: 代数的マルチグリッド（AMG）

note.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
note.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

note.en: Householder reflectors triangularize R while accumulating Q. Least squares uses triangular back substitution for QR and truncated compact SVD for deficient rank.

name.ja: DSMC・運動論輸送
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
note.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

note.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
note.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

name.ja: Lie–Trotter分割
Strang分割
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
note.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

note.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
note.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

name.ja: Rusanov／局所Lax–Friedrichs流束
Heun法／SSPRK(2,2)
MUSCL再構成
Minmod
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
note.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

note.ja: 初版r1はMacで22単体検査・48判定が合格しましたが、公開ZIPのLinux追試では警告を例外にする設定でCFL比のoverflowにより失敗しました。r2は代数的に等価な逆数最大率へ評価順を変更し、元の入力・参照・受入基準48条件を維持。r2専用の実行前hash契約を保存してから、警告を例外にした23検査と全4計算・48判定が合格しました。初版のソース・契約・Linux失敗記録も保存しています。参照は独立な相似ODEのDOP853積分、エネルギー規格化、中心ξ<.001の正則漸近形と衝撃位置で分割する殻求積です。16/32点求積・中心cutoff/ODE公差を別々に確認。固定commitの未改変ExactPackを6001/12001点で別実行し、中心とジャンプから離れた点を事前基準5e-4で照合しました。β=1.15166641793、Rs(.05)=.34746791233。原点・衝撃波を含むr≤1.2Rsの体積重み密度L1は.17257/.12785/.07458、圧力L1は.18148/.13939/.07615。512セルの衝撃位置誤差は1.096セル、最大離散収支残差は約8.89e-16です。
note.en: Original r1 passed22 tests and48 gates on Mac, but its public-ZIP Linux run failed when warnings-as-errors raised a cold-tail CFL overflow. Revision r2 uses the algebraically equivalent reciprocal maximum-rate evaluation while preserving the original inputs, reference and48 acceptance gates. A new r2-specific pre-execution hash contract precedes23 tests and all four calculations/48 gates passing with warnings as errors. Original sources, contract and actual Linux-failure evidence remain archived. The independent reference integrates the similarity ODE with DOP853, normalizes energy, uses a regular asymptote for xi<.001 and split shell quadrature at the shock. Orders16/32, core cutoff and ODE tolerance are checked separately. The unmodified pinned ExactPack evaluator was independently run at6001/12001 points and compared away from the center/jump with its preregistered5e-4 criterion. Beta=1.15166641793, Rs(.05)=.34746791233. Origin/shock-inclusive volume-weighted density L1 within r<=1.2Rs is.17257/.12785/.07458 and pressure L1 is.18148/.13939/.07615. Finest shock error is1.096 cells; maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about8.89e-16.

name.ja: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解
name.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution

note.ja: 半解析解 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。 エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

name.en: Double Mach reflection: saved independent finite-grid numerical reference

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 領域[0,4]×[0,1]の2次元理想気体Euler、γ=1.4、Mach10・角度60度の入射衝撃波、初期の衝撃脚x=1/6、最終時刻T=.2。保存参照は別実装の非分割primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun有限体積法（勾配制限はgeneralized minmodのθ=1.5、MC型であり標準MCのθ=2とは異なる）で、256×64と512×128セルです。主計算とHLLという流束族・Heun時間積分の数式を共有しますが、空間再構成と実装は別です。保存量を保つ制限で比較用セル平均を得ます。不変のRKDG2Dキットで以前に実行したソース・配列・記録を再利用し、今回の参照PDE・Athena・LAVAの新規実行ではありません。参照の格子差も有限分解能の感度指標で、厳密な誤差上界ではありません。厳密2D解でも細いwall jet・渦構造の収束検証でもありません。 入射不連続面の初期化はセル中心での状態判定であり、衝撃面で切られたセルの厳密平均からの初期化ではありません。 以前に独立実行した2格子の有限体積参照を保存量制限で比較します。有限格子数値参照であり、厳密2D解や誤差上界ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow on [0,4] × [0,1], with gamma = 1.4, a Mach-10 incident shock at 60 degrees, initial shock foot x = 1/6 and final time T = 0.2. The saved reference uses a separately written, unsplit primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun finite-volume code on 256 × 64 and 512 × 128 cells. Its generalized-minmod slope parameter is theta = 1.5 (MC-type, rather than canonical MC with theta = 2). The primary and reference codes share the HLL flux family and Heun time-integration equations, while their spatial reconstruction and implementations are separate. Conservative restriction produces comparison cell means. Previously executed source, data and receipts are reused from the immutable RKDG2D kit; no reference PDE, Athena or LAVA was executed anew for this addition. Reference grid differences indicate finite-resolution sensitivity, not rigorous error bounds. This is not an analytic 2D solution or a convergence test for the thin wall jet and vortex pattern. The incident discontinuity is classified at cell centers, rather than initialized from exact cut-cell averages. Compare against two previously independently executed finite-volume reference grids using conservative restriction. This is a finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact2D solution or error bound.

The right-hand side of the representative Poisson equation below is 4πGρ here; fully periodic boundaries and softened particle systems are different cases. Compare with φ=2πz² after aligning the additive gauge; check acceleration -4πz and the zero horizontal mode.

The Poisson right-hand side is 4πGρ; this differs from fully periodic fields or softened particle-pair forces. note.ja: リンクは静電Poisson/Laplace場です。中性周期Coulomb電荷のEwald/PME問題であり、重力の質量・符号・境界を流用しません。 同じ中性周期電荷・規約の収束したEwald和、力の有限差分とカットオフ・格子収束を確認します。孤立重力粒子の直接和とは境界・相互作用が異なります。 追加版は同じ中性8点電荷・立方体・tin-foil規約のエネルギーと全粒子力を、別実装theta積分と参照自身の細分化に照合します。SPMEはB-splineのエネルギー勾配型であり、原Lagrange PMEや厳密運動量保存を主張しません。
note.en: The link is the electrostatic Poisson/Laplace field. This is neutral periodic Coulomb Ewald/PME, not an interchange of gravitational masses, signs or boundaries. Check converged Ewald sums for identical neutral periodic charges/conventions, force finite differences and cutoff/mesh refinement. Boundaries and interactions differ from isolated gravitational direct sums. The companion compares energy and every force for the same neutral eight-charge cubic tin-foil cell against a separately implemented theta integral and its own refinement. SPME uses B-spline energy gradients; original Lagrange PME and exact momentum conservation are not claimed.

note.ja: 2次元Poisson/Laplaceの対数Green核を用いる粒子和です。3次元軟化重力1/rモデルとは区別します。 同じ2次元対数核と粒子配置の直接和を数値基準に、多重極の次数・階層変換・力誤差を確認します。3次元1/r核の基準は流用しません。 追加版ではCartesian直接和と解析配置を別の基準にし、展開次数と木深さを分離します。深さに対する単調収束や3次元Coulomb核の精度・計算量を保証しません。
note.en: A particle sum with the logarithmic Green kernel of 2D Poisson/Laplace, distinct from softened 3D 1/r gravity. Use direct summation with the same 2D logarithmic kernel and particles to check expansion order, hierarchical translations and force error. Do not reuse a 3D 1/r reference. The companion uses Cartesian direct sums and analytic configurations as separate references, varying expansion order and tree depth independently. It guarantees neither monotonic error with depth nor accuracy/complexity for a 3D Coulomb kernel.

note.ja: Poissonへのリンクは自己無撞着な静電場の部分です。粒子の運動・CIC補間を結合したPIC全体の式が一覧に揃っているわけではありません。 小振幅の冷たいプラズマの線形変位cos(t)と比較し、電荷整合性・Poisson残差・自己力、格子系列と時間刻み系列を確認します。一般の非線形PIC軌道の厳密解という主張ではありません。 追加版は静止イオン背景のまま、電荷・運動量・粒子と場のエネルギーを軌道誤差と分けます。小振幅線形参照であり、熱的Landau減衰や電磁PICの根拠ではありません。
note.en: Poisson identifies the self-consistent electrostatic field; the registry does not list the complete coupled particle-motion/CIC PIC system. Compare with linear cold-plasma displacement cos(t); check charge compatibility, Poisson residual, self force, and separate grid/timestep series. This is not an exact reference for general nonlinear PIC trajectories. The companion retains stationary background ions and separates charge, momentum and particle/field-energy diagnostics from trajectory error. Its reference is small-amplitude linear theory, supplying no evidence for thermal Landau damping or electromagnetic PIC.

note.en: A particle sum with the logarithmic Green kernel of 2D Poisson/Laplace, distinct from softened 3D 1/r gravity. Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors.

note.ja: Poissonへのリンクは自己無撞着な静電場の部分です。粒子の運動・CIC補間を結合したPIC全体の式が一覧に揃っているわけではありません。 1次元周期セルの電子をCICで格子と結び、Poisson方程式と粒子運動を自洽に進めます。
note.en: Poisson identifies the self-consistent electrostatic field; the registry does not list the complete coupled particle-motion/CIC PIC system. Couple electrons to a 1D periodic grid by CIC, solving Poisson and particle motion self-consistently.

Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. note.ja: 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。 この問題に明示的に対応するct-glm-smooth-convergence配布例のCTとGLMです。同じLLF係数と時間刻みを使っても、磁場配置・角電場平均・法線場の扱いが異なる離散系全体の比較です。この発散ゼロの物理例を、別の非物理制約対照で測った能動的なcleaning性能と同一視しません。
note.en: Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages. CT and GLM are explicitly bound by the ct-glm-smooth-convergence release example. Matching LLF coefficients and time steps still compares whole discretizations with different magnetic placement, corner EMF averaging and normal-field handling. This solenoidal physical example is distinct from active-cleaning measurements in the separate nonphysical constraint control.

note.ja: 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。 構成厳密解の保存変数セル平均と格子誤差を比較します。固定した空間RHSを独立DOP853時間積分で解いた参照は時間誤差の確認用であり、別の空間ソルバーとは呼びません。18件の既存参照解ライブラリにはこの構成解のカードがないため、別問題の参照カードを流用せず、該当実行例の式・結果・ソースへ案内します。
note.en: Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages. Compare spatial errors against conserved cell averages of the constructed exact solution. Independent DOP853 integration of the same fixed spatial RHS checks temporal error and is not a separate spatial solver. The existing 18-case reference-solution library has no card for this constructed solution, so use the bound example’s equations, results and source rather than borrowing another problem’s reference card.

note.ja: 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。
note.en: Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages. Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence.

text.ja: ロジスティック個体群増殖 \dot N=rN(1-N/K) 収容力Kを持つ密度依存の連続時間増殖モデル。離散ロジスティック写像とは区別します。 限定した実行例：無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。
text.en: Logistic population growth \dot N=rN(1-N/K) Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

text.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み u_t=D_u\Delta u+f(u,v) v_t=D_v\Delta v+g(u,v) 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
text.en: Turing reaction–diffusion framework u_t=D_u\Delta u+f(u,v) v_t=D_v\Delta v+g(u,v) A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

text.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion u_t=D_u\Delta u+a-u+u^2v v_t=D_v\Delta v+b-u^2v A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

note.ja: 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
note.en: Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p. An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

name.ja: Noh問題：実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算
name.en: Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation

note.ja: 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array.

title.ja: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解
title.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution

keywords: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解
Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution

text.ja: Sedov–Taylorの点爆発：エネルギー正規化した球対称自己相似解 R_s(t)=beta*(E0*t^2/rho0)^(1/5), beta≈1.15166641793; D=2*R_s/(5*t); rho=rho0*G(r/R_s), u=D*V(r/R_s), p=rho0*D^2*P(r/R_s). 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。
text.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: energy-normalized spherical similarity solution R_s(t)=beta*(E0*t^2/rho0)^(1/5), beta≈1.15166641793; D=2*R_s/(5*t); rho=rho0*G(r/R_s), u=D*V(r/R_s), p=rho0*D^2*P(r/R_s). Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic.

name.ja: Rusanov／局所Lax–Friedrichs流束

note.ja: エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。 区分定数のRusanov有限体積流束とSSPRK2/Heunを使う限定した球半径例です。
note.en: An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors. A scoped spherical-radial example using piecewise-constant Rusanov finite-volume fluxes and SSPRK2/Heun.

title.ja: Double Mach反射：保存済み独立有限格子数値参照
title.en: Double Mach reflection: saved independent finite-grid numerical reference

keywords: Double Mach反射：保存済み独立有限格子数値参照
Double Mach reflection: saved independent finite-grid numerical reference

text.ja: Double Mach反射：保存済み独立有限格子数値参照 partial_t U + partial_x F(U) + partial_y G(U) = 0; Uref_C = sum_f(|C_f| Uref_f)/|C| (conservative restriction of saved finite-grid data). 領域[0,4]×[0,1]の2次元理想気体Euler、γ=1.4、Mach10・角度60度の入射衝撃波、初期の衝撃脚x=1/6、最終時刻T=.2。保存参照は別実装の非分割primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun有限体積法（勾配制限はgeneralized minmodのθ=1.5、MC型であり標準MCのθ=2とは異なる）で、256×64と512×128セルです。主計算とHLLという流束族・Heun時間積分の数式を共有しますが、空間再構成と実装は別です。保存量を保つ制限で比較用セル平均を得ます。不変のRKDG2Dキットで以前に実行したソース・配列・記録を再利用し、今回の参照PDE・Athena・LAVAの新規実行ではありません。参照の格子差も有限分解能の感度指標で、厳密な誤差上界ではありません。厳密2D解でも細いwall jet・渦構造の収束検証でもありません。 入射不連続面の初期化はセル中心での状態判定であり、衝撃面で切られたセルの厳密平均からの初期化ではありません。
text.en: Double Mach reflection: saved independent finite-grid numerical reference partial_t U + partial_x F(U) + partial_y G(U) = 0; Uref_C = sum_f(|C_f| Uref_f)/|C| (conservative restriction of saved finite-grid data). Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow on [0,4] × [0,1], with gamma = 1.4, a Mach-10 incident shock at 60 degrees, initial shock foot x = 1/6 and final time T = 0.2. The saved reference uses a separately written, unsplit primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun finite-volume code on 256 × 64 and 512 × 128 cells. Its generalized-minmod slope parameter is theta = 1.5 (MC-type, rather than canonical MC with theta = 2). The primary and reference codes share the HLL flux family and Heun time-integration equations, while their spatial reconstruction and implementations are separate. Conservative restriction produces comparison cell means. Previously executed source, data and receipts are reused from the immutable RKDG2D kit; no reference PDE, Athena or LAVA was executed anew for this addition. Reference grid differences indicate finite-resolution sensitivity, not rigorous error bounds. This is not an analytic 2D solution or a convergence test for the thin wall jet and vortex pattern. The incident discontinuity is classified at cell centers, rather than initialized from exact cut-cell averages.
